title: Sales Executive
must_have: 1+ years of experience in business sales
text:
Sales Executive
Tapti Industries | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a sales executive to join our business sales team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Negotiation
- Account Management
- Lead Generation
- B2B Sales
- Cold Outreach
- 1+ years of experience in business sales

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Tender Responses
- CRM
- Channel Partnerships
- Market Mapping

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive enterprise accounts in the western region with measurable outcomes.
- Drive channel onboarding with measurable outcomes.
- Drive mid-market segment launch with measurable outcomes.
